explanation: Son of King Saul and a close friend of David. He helps David in his flight from Saul's anger.
Future king of Israel and a central figure in the Old Testament. In 1 Samuel 20 he is fleeing from King Saul.
The first king of Israel, who becomes jealous of David and tries to kill him several times.
An agreement or commitment between two parties, often with religious connotations. Jonathan and David make a covenant of friendship and loyalty.
A weapon consisting of an arrow and a bow. Jonathan uses this as a signal to David that it is not safe to return to Saul's court.
An open area where Jonathan and David meet to discuss their situation and plan David's escape.
An occasion when food is served and eaten. King Saul arranges a meal, and his anger over David's absence reveals his hostility toward David.
